_about: Every sensor of the cold room. Positions are in metres: x = east, y = up (from the top of the concrete pad), z = south (the door side). Origin = centre of the room. 'tag': M = measured by a sensor, C = calculated by a formula from other values, E = estimated / design value, AI = prediction. In SIMULATED mode the 'measured' values come from the digital twin. 'quantity' is the key in /api/state.

sensors.name: Outside air temperature
sensors.type: SHT31 digital T/RH sensor in a radiation shield
sensors.location: Weather mast, 1.5 m high, 1.5 m south-east of the room
sensors.used_in: Q_wall = U·A·(T_out − T_in); door infiltration enthalpy h_out; T_cond = T_out + 10 K; PV cell temperature

sensors.name: Outside relative humidity
sensors.location: Weather mast, in the radiation shield
sensors.used_in: Humidity ratio W_out → enthalpy h_out → door latent load

sensors.name: Wind speed
sensors.location: Top of the weather mast, 2.2 m
sensors.used_in: Logged for context (wind raises door infiltration in real rooms; not in the ASHRAE formula)

sensors.name: Solar PV power
sensors.location: PV combiner, on the canopy frame
sensors.used_in: P = P_rated·(G/1000)·PR·[1 − 0.004·(T_cell − 25)]; decides solar vs grid (ATS)

sensors.name: Compressor power
sensors.location: Condensing unit on the east wall
sensors.used_in: COP_elec = Q_cooling / P_comp; physics check of room temperature

sensors.name: Grid backup switch (ATS)
sensors.type: Contact on the automatic transfer switch
sensors.used_in: Grid backup hours; switches when PCM < 15 % and no sun

sensors.name: Door switch
sensors.location: Top of the door frame, handle side
sensors.used_in: D_t = fraction of time open → Q_door = q·D_t·D_f·(1 − E)

sensors.name: Door angle
sensors.type: Magnetic rotary encoder (AS5600) on the hinge
sensors.used_in: Effective door opening area during swing (animation)

sensors.name: Doorway air speed – top (warm air in)
sensors.used_in: Checks the Gosney–Olama flow: v ≈ 2·V̇/A, V̇ = 0.221·A·√(gH(1 − ρ_out/ρ_in))·F_m

sensors.name: Doorway air speed – middle (neutral line)
sensors.used_in: Should read ≈ 0 at the neutral plane (stack flow changes direction here)

sensors.name: Doorway air speed – bottom (cold air out)
sensors.used_in: Cold air spilling out; same flow as the top by mass balance

sensors.name: Pressure difference across the doorway (top)
sensors.location: Pressure ports inside and outside, above the door
sensors.used_in: Stack pressure Δp = (ρ_in − ρ_out)·g·H/2 drives the door air exchange

sensors.name: Room temperature – low
sensors.used_in: Room air temperature (the twin has ONE air node, so all room sensors show the same value in SIMULATED mode)

sensors.name: Room T / RH – middle
sensors.used_in: Main control sensor; Q_wall, door enthalpy h_in, shelf life

sensors.name: Room temperature – high
sensors.used_in: Stratification check (warm air collects at the top)

sensors.name: PCM slab temperature
sensors.type: Type-T thermocouple in the wax + MAX31856
sensors.location: Inside a wax panel, west wall
sensors.used_in: PCM battery state (with the energy balance) and backup time

sensors.name: Product (pulp) temperature
sensors.used_in: Product pull-down: Q = m·cp·dT/dt; shelf-life model

sensors.name: Ethylene / VOC gas (optional)
sensors.used_in: Ripening / spoilage trend only. NOT simulated – shows a value only when a real sensor is connected.

computed.name: Wax battery
computed.used_in: frozen fraction from the PCM energy balance

computed.name: COP (electrical)
computed.used_in: R290 cycle, CoolProp, T_cond = T_out + 10 K
